description:
Provisions a database or cache. THIS COSTS MONEY — the plan is billed monthly from creation until the instance is deleted.

Storage is not a parameter: it starts at the plan's included storage; grow it later with resize_storage. Creating runs in the background, so this returns an instance id and an actionId immediately. Poll get_action with the actionId until it reports "Success" (the instance is then "active") or "Failure".

engine.description: Engine version, e.g. "postgres@17" or just "17". Omit for the default.

group.description: database for PostgreSQL, cache for Valkey/Redis

region.description: Region name (e.g. fsn1) or city from list_regions. Required: there is no default.

tier.description: Plan name from list_plans, e.g. AKPG-5

name: create_instance
title: Create an instance
